pkgmetadata.longdescription: wxWidgets 3.3 (slot 3.3-gtk3), installable in parallel with the 3.2-gtk3 slot from ::gentoo. Carried here for media-gfx/prusaslicer 3.x, which requires wxWidgets 3.3.

use.flag: Enable the wxMediaCtrl class for playing audio and video through gstreamer.
Use Simple Directmedia Layer (media-libs/libsdl2) for audio.

slots.slot: Slots reflect MAJOR.MINOR versions which can be installed in parallel.
